mailServicePolicy.label: Legal
mailServicePolicy.title: Mail Service Policy
mailServicePolicy.intro: This Mail Service Policy describes how {owner} ({siteName}) uses email services on {siteUrl}, including email sent through Google Gmail and related Google application credentials. This policy applies to visitors who submit the contact form, subscribe to updates, or otherwise communicate with us by email.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.body: {siteName} operates a portfolio website at {siteUrl}. Email is used only to support legitimate site operations: responding to contact inquiries, sending transactional confirmations, and delivering newsletter content to subscribers who opt in. We do not use email for unsolicited bulk messaging or advertising on behalf of third parties.

provider.title: 2. Mail service provider
provider.body: Outbound and notification email for this website is delivered using Google Gmail through an authorized Google application (Gmail API / app credentials). Google processes message transmission on our behalf in accordance with Google's terms and privacy policies. {siteName} remains the data controller for information you submit through this site.

purposes.title: 3. Purposes of email use
purposes.body:
We use email to:
• Notify {owner} when a visitor submits the contact form.
• Send an automated confirmation to the sender after a contact form submission.
• Send welcome and update messages to newsletter subscribers who provide consent.
• Respond manually to inquiries when follow-up is required.

We do not use email data for unrelated profiling, resale, or third-party marketing.

data_collected.title: 4. Information collected
data_collected.body:
Depending on how you interact with the site, we may process:
• Your name and email address (contact form or newsletter signup).
• Subject line and message content you provide.
• Technical metadata necessary to deliver email (timestamps, delivery status).

We do not request or store Gmail mailbox contents beyond what you voluntarily submit through this website.

data_use.title: 5. How we use email information
data_use.body: Information is used solely to operate the mail service described above, prevent abuse (including rate limiting), maintain service reliability, and comply with applicable law. We do not sell, rent, or trade your email address or message content to third parties.

storage_security.title: 6. Storage and security
storage_security.body: Contact and subscription records may be stored in secure application databases and email systems under our control. Access is limited to {owner} and systems required to operate the website. We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data, but no method of transmission or storage is completely secure.

google_limited_use.title: 7. Google API Services User Data Policy
google_limited_use.body: If Google user data is accessed through Google APIs, {siteName}'s use of that information complies with the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. Google user data is used only to provide or improve user-facing features of this site, is not transferred to third parties except as necessary to provide the service, and is not used for serving advertisements.

retention.title: 8. Retention
retention.body: Contact form correspondence is retained only as long as needed to respond to inquiries and maintain reasonable business records. Newsletter subscriber records are kept until you unsubscribe or request deletion. You may request removal of your data at any time using the contact details below.

your_rights.title: 9. Your rights
your_rights.body: Under applicable data protection law, including the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) in South Africa, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you. Newsletter subscribers can stop receiving emails by using unsubscribe instructions in any message or by contacting us directly.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this Mail Service Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page will reflect the most recent revision. Continued use of the site's email features after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

voiceAgentPrivacy.label: Legal
voiceAgentPrivacy.title: Voice Agent Privacy Policy
voiceAgentPrivacy.intro: This Voice Agent Privacy Policy describes how {owner} ({siteName}) collects and uses personal information when you talk to the NJMTECH AI voice agent, whether by calling or messaging our WhatsApp Business number (+27 79 434 7162) or by using a web-based voice demo linked from {siteUrl}.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.body: The NJMTECH voice agent is an automated assistant powered by artificial intelligence. It answers questions, looks up business information and can take actions such as creating bookings. When you call or message it, you are speaking to software, not a person. We process only the information needed to hold the conversation, complete your request and keep the service secure and reliable.

data_collected.title: 2. Information we collect
data_collected.body:
When you use the voice agent we may process:
• Your WhatsApp phone number, WhatsApp profile name and call or message identifiers provided by Meta.
• The audio of your call or voice note, which is converted to text in real time.
• Text transcripts of the conversation, including the agent's replies.
• Information you choose to share, such as your name, the service you want and a preferred date and time for a booking.
• Technical metadata such as call start and end times, delivery status and error logs.

how_it_works.title: 3. How the voice agent processes your conversation
how_it_works.body:
During a call or voice note:
• Your speech is transcribed to text by a speech-to-text provider.
• The transcript is sent to a large language model, which generates a reply and may request business information or an action (such as a booking) from our own systems.
• The reply is converted back into speech by a text-to-speech model running on cloud GPU infrastructure and played or sent back to you.

Call audio is processed as a live stream and is not recorded or stored by {siteName}. Transcripts and a short automated summary of each call are kept as described in the Retention section.

service_providers.title: 4. Service providers
service_providers.body:
We use the following providers to operate the voice agent. Each processes data on our behalf under its own terms and privacy policy:
• Meta Platforms (WhatsApp Business Platform) for WhatsApp calls and messages.
• Deepgram for real-time speech-to-text on calls.
• Cloudflare for secure network tunnelling and speech-to-text on voice notes (Workers AI).
• Anthropic for the Claude language model that generates replies.
• Modal for the cloud GPUs that run our text-to-speech model.

Some of these providers process data outside South Africa. Where personal information is transferred across borders, we rely on providers that apply safeguards consistent with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

data_use.title: 5. How we use your information
data_use.body:
We use your information to:
• Understand and answer your questions during the conversation.
• Complete actions you ask for, such as creating or confirming a booking.
• Follow up on your request where the agent could not resolve it.
• Monitor quality, fix errors and prevent abuse of the service.

We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information, we do not use it for advertising, and we do not use your conversations to train AI models.

retention.title: 6. Retention
retention.body: Call audio is not stored. Conversation transcripts, call summaries and short message history used to keep context in WhatsApp conversations are kept only as long as needed to provide the service and handle follow-ups, and are periodically deleted. Booking details are kept for as long as reasonably required to deliver and administer the booking. You can ask us to delete your information at any time.

storage_security.title: 7. Storage and security
storage_security.body: Information is stored in systems under our control and in the systems of the providers listed above. Access is limited to {owner} and the systems required to operate the voice agent. Connections between components are encrypted, and access keys are kept secret. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we apply reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect your data.

your_rights.title: 8. Your rights and choices
your_rights.body: Under POPIA you may request access to, correction of or deletion of the personal information we hold about you, and object to its processing. You can stop using the voice agent at any time by ending the call or no longer messaging the number. To exercise your rights, contact us using the details below. You may also lodge a complaint with the Information Regulator of South Africa.

children.title: 9. Children
children.body: The voice agent is not intended for children under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has used the service, contact us and we will delete the related information.

changes.title: 10. Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this Voice Agent Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page reflects the most recent revision. Continued use of the voice agent after changes are posted means you accept the updated policy.

contact.title: 11. Contact
